summary: Master sanctions screening and TBML controls in 5 days. Build escalation matrices, red-flag registers, and audit-ready reporting with TrainingCred.
lede: Sanctions screening and trade-based money laundering controls involve reviewing alerts and trade activity for suspicious patterns. For trade finance, sanctions, and financial crime professionals, the course develops skills in checking counterparties and goods, spotting invoice, shipment, and payment inconsistencies, and documenting investigation findings and escalation decisions.
audienceIntro: This course is built for professionals who work directly with sanctions screening, trade finance review, trade-based money laundering detection, and financial crime escalation workflows. Sanctions Analysts reviewing trade and payment alerts. Trade Finance Officers checking document consistency and shipment risk. AML Investigators escalating suspected trade-based money laundering cases. KYC Analysts refreshing counterparty and beneficial ownership data. Financial Crime Compliance Managers overseeing sanctions screening governance. Trade Operations Managers coordinating maker-checker review controls. Transaction Monitoring Specialists linking payments to trade anomalies. Correspondent Banking Officers assessing cross-border exposure. Screening System Administrators tuning watchlist workflows and dispositions. Fraud and Risk Analysts supporting trade document exception review.
prerequisites: You should bring familiarity with AML, sanctions screening, KYC, or trade finance processes. Participants benefit from access to a laptop, spreadsheet software, and, where available, samples of sanctions alerts, invoices, bills of lading, and internal escalation templates.
